extension.description: Manage local and remote Clash/Mihomo instances from VS Code.
view.container.title: Clash Manager
view.sidebar.name: Control Center
configuration.title: Clash Manager
configuration.language.description: Display language used by Clash Manager. English is the default.
configuration.transport.description: Run clashctl locally or through OpenSSH.
configuration.sshTarget.description: OpenSSH host alias or target. Authentication is handled by OpenSSH.
configuration.clashctlPath.description: Path or command name for clashctl on the target.
configuration.autoRefresh.description: Refresh the active target automatically while the sidebar is visible.
configuration.commandTimeout.description: Timeout for non-streaming commands in seconds.
configuration.controllerUrl.description: Optional Mihomo Controller base URL. Leave empty to discover it from clashctl status.
configuration.controllerAutoDiscover.des: Try to discover the Controller URL and secret from clashctl output.
configuration.showSensitiveAddresses.des: Show full proxy and Controller addresses. Secrets are never shown.
